topic: Visual Design Systems, Typography, Color, and Accessibility
learningObjectives: Apply typography and visual hierarchy principles to interface design.
Choose colors and spacing that support usability and consistency.
Identify accessibility considerations for digital interfaces.

activities.title: Visual Hierarchy Explorer
activities.instruction: Adjust visual properties to reveal hierarchy changes.

content.concept: Visual hierarchy uses size, weight, spacing, contrast, and position to guide attention through an interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Typography Match
activities.instruction: Match typography choices to interface purposes.

content.concept: Typography choices affect readability, hierarchy, tone, and consistency across digital products.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Color Accessibility Lab
activities.instruction: Select accessible color combinations for each interface.

content.concept: Accessible color choices provide sufficient contrast and should not rely on color alone to communicate meaning.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Design System Builder
activities.instruction: Compose reusable tokens and interface components.

content.concept: A design system combines reusable visual tokens and components to maintain consistency across an interface.
